spec.assertion: Boss-held buffApply (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) at value -13.77 exists, and its count is < shots/2 — RED under the nearest-wrong shotFired trigger (which would fire ~1 per shot on a 6-round magazine) and RED under an ally/self target scope (which would carry a non-null targetIdx).

Same boss-held pair asserted as present at -13.77; the defPct half is encoded even though v1 boss-DEF handling makes it damage-inert. RED under a model that silently drops the DEF half as 'defensive'.

Counterfactual removing skill2's stack source must not increase the -13.77 debuff stream (and should reduce it) — RED under an ungated lastBullet block, which would be indifferent to the stack source.

reloadSpeedPct===95 applications on exia are exactly 1:1 with fullBurstStart events, self-targeted, no durationShots — RED under burstCast keying (fires pre-FB, decoupled from FB count in a multi-burster rotation) and RED under a rounds-duration reading.

Deleting the reload buff strictly reduces exia's shot count and total damage — RED under the 'reload speed is defensive, skip it' failure mode. ⚑ The word FIXED (a stat CLAMP, not an additive buff) is a distinct primitive per the schema note; modeled here as an additive reloadSpeedPct because no clamp primitive exists — flagged, not silently equated.

Self atkPct===28 with maxStacks===5, seconds-duration, and application count > 2× fullBurstStart count — RED under an FB/burst-keyed trigger and RED under a maxStacks-1 or rounds-duration reading. Non-vacuity: removing it strictly drops exia's own total.

casterAtkPct events carry a FLAT-resolved ATK value (>100, not the literal 5.8) with maxStacks===5 and no durationShots — RED under emitting the raw percentage and RED under an atkPct (target-scaled) encoding.

Recipient set is non-empty AND a strict subset of the comp's slugs — RED under an untyped {kind:'allies'} target, which would cover every slot. The fixed-B3 helm slot supplies the required non-Electric ally for the exclusion half.

burstCast events for exia > 0 and burst-bucket damage events all carry fbMajorApplied falsy — RED under a model that lets burst-cast damage take the +50% Full Burst major (a burst cast lands before the FB window opens).
A boss-held buffApply at -2.71 exists — RED under dropping the small DEF debuff as noise.

Rider applications ≤ burst casts, AND removing the 28% stack source strictly reduces the rider's firing count — RED under an ungated 'fires every burst' rider. This is the non-vacuity proof that the max-stack gate is real.

damageTakenPct===18.04 emitted with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null, and removing it strictly reduces at least one TEAMMATE's total — RED under the recurring 'Damage Taken ▲ is a self buff' failure mode, under which allies would be byte-identical.
it.skip — the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so the target-count/ranking clause has no observable payload in v1.
No buffApply on exia carries durationShots — the kit states only wall-clock seconds (5/10/15). RED under the recurring 'for N round(s)' mis-read applied to any of these lines.
No pierceDamagePct events — the kit text carries no Pierce clause, so neither hasPierce nor gainPierce belongs to this unit.

fixtures: controlComp('exia', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / exia / helm B3, boss Fire, focus exia. Exia is Burst I: without a B2+B3 chain no Full Burst ever occurs, which would make the skill1-B fullBurstEnter line vacuous. The fixed B3 (helm) is deliberately KEPT rather than passed false: exia's two team-facing effects are (a) an ENEMY debuff (damageTakenPct, identified by casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null, so ally buffs cannot confound the filter) and (b) an ELECTRIC-only ally grant, where a non-Electric teammate is REQUIRED to prove the element filter actually excludes someone. Helm's own ally buffs shift absolute totals but every assertion here is either event-structural or a same-fixture A/B counterfactual, so the shared baseline cancels. Counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride mutate ov.skill1/.skill2/.burst .blocks in-memory only. 5 runs total (1 baseline + 4 counterfactuals), well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: burst block A target clause '10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' — it.skip: the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so multi-enemy targeting and final-DEF ranking have no observable payload in v1.

DEF ▼ magnitude (13.77% skill1 / 2.71% burst) — it.skip on end-to-end damage assertion: v1 boss-DEF handling makes the DEF halves damage-inert, so only their ENCODING (the buffApply emission) is assertable, not their effect.

⚑ FLAG (not a skip): skill1 block B says reload speed is 'FIXED at a 95% increase', a stat CLAMP, which the schema explicitly distinguishes from an additive buff ('NOT for "reload speed is FIXED at x" lines — those are stat CLAMPS, a different primitive', docs/engine-modeling-gaps.md §1b). No clamp primitive exists, so the test asserts the additive reloadSpeedPct=95 encoding as the available approximation. If exia carries any OTHER reload-speed source, additive-vs-clamp diverge and the model over-credits; flagged for the driver rather than assumed equivalent.

⚑ FLAG: the skill2-B ally grant's exact recipient count depends on how many Electric allies the control comp contains; the assertion is therefore a strict-subset test rather than a pinned count, so it stays valid under a comp change while still discriminating an untyped allies target.
